title: Right tensor presentations of complete algebroids
statement: Use coherent categories and full functor simplicial sets of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the monoidal operadic base of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category], complete algebroids of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], ordered action words and inert transports of [def-coef-coherent-bar-word-data], and coherent adjunctions of [def-coef-coherent-adjunction-data]. A right tensor presentation consists of a cocartesian word-operadic right action with terminal left coefficient, the specified monoidal right coefficient category, and a complete algebroid together with its coherent universal evaluation into this action. Its object space is identified with the core of the mixed-letter category. The evaluation lies over the word obtained by prepending a module letter; its inert pure-coefficient projection is the specified complete algebroid. Each active evaluation is a terminal tensor comma object, and the Hom bifunctor represents tensor-Hom adjunction on all three variables, as an equivalence of the mapping-space left fibrations [lem-coef-twisted-arrow-left-fibration]. A linear functor is a map over the word base fixing coefficients and preserving cocartesian transports. A linear adjunction has unit and counit cylinders over that base, identity on coefficients, restricting to the given coherent adjunction, with compatible linear triangle simplices. These data express tensored enrichment and tensor-preserving enriched adjunctions, including all operation and parameter simplices.
